# PR Reviews

When doing a PR review and you find a change that needs to be made. Invoke Kelos Operator with "/iterate" in the PR conversations tab as a regular comment (ensure the comment only contains the keyword "/iterate" and/or "ready-check") but if nothing is wrong add "/ready-check" in the conversations tab instead. we are using https://github.com/kelos-dev/kelos to automate this repo further.
